title: A vocabulary gives pieces IDs
summary: A tokenizer can map text pieces to numeric IDs. These numbers are labels for pieces, not scores of how important a word is.
introduction: A tokenizer can map text pieces to numeric IDs. These numbers are labels for pieces, not scores of how important a word is. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain a vocabulary gives pieces ids
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A tokenizer can map text pieces to numeric IDs. These numbers are labels for pieces, not scores of how important a word is.

blocks.title: A vocabulary gives pieces IDs

blocks.text: The output is [1, 2]. Each word finds its assigned ID. The fallback 0 represents a missing word in this toy vocabulary.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Encode boat flies and explain the first ID.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A larger token ID does not mean a more important token.
For more detail later, use this [Large Language Models further reading](https://huggingface.co/learn/llm-course/chapter1/1).
